name: ITCONS E-Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, ITCONS e-Solutions Ltd is in the business of Recruitment and staffing services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ITCONS is a staffing and recruitment company specializing in IT consulting, general staffing, and permanent staffing solutions across various sectors. It provides SLA/KPI-based business solutions, project management support, and general staffing services to clients in India. The company is also exploring new verticals, including the green energy sector, and has entered the solar power segment by establishing power plants.

cons: Stock is trading at 8.17 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.44%
